newsitem.title: USA: BP has problems with Louisiana catcracker - source.
newsitem.headline: BP has problems with Louisiana catcracker - source.

text.p: Problems with a catalytic cracker at BP America's refinery in Belle Chasse, Louisiana sharply firmed differentials on Gulf Coast gasoline grades Monday afternoon, traders said.

"There's a problem at the cracker," a products trader said, noting it had helped firm spot conventional unleaded gasoline prices in U.S. Gulf markets as much as 1.50 cents a gallon to 1.25 cents below November futures.
-- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk 212 859-1632

"We've got turnarounds going right now and anything that's unscheduled tweaks the market," a Gulf trader said, pegging prompt front-29th cycle Gulf conventional unleaded at between one cent and 1.25 cents under November futures.

"The immediate reason is the BP problem," said another trader, noting values were also firming because of ongoing scheduled turnarounds at Sun Co Inc's refinery in Marcus Hook, Penn., and at Amerada Hess' giant refinery in St. Croix.
The refinery has a crude capacity of 231,500 barrels per day with cat cracking capacity of 96,300 bpd.
-- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1632
